beats.say: You missed one of cricket's best deals. An IPL team that cost 67 million dollars. Guess its price today.
2008. Vijay Mallya pays 111.6 million dollars for Bengaluru.
और सबसे सस्ती टीम? Rajasthan Royals. सिर्फ 67 million.
beats.cap: And the cheapest team? Rajasthan Royals. Just 67 million.

beats.say: फिर twist आया। सबसे सस्ती टीम ने पहला IPL जीत लिया।
beats.cap: Then the twist. The cheapest team won the very first IPL.

beats.say: 2026. Bengaluru sells at 1.78 billion dollars. Sixteen times.
